text:
maria: Heads up — found another billing/compat mismatch. Tenants with legacy client tokens are being silently routed to a compatibility shim that tags requests with `route_alias=compat` and still increments the v2 quota. Billing sees v2 only; console shows deprecated badge for v1 callers but no clear served-variant.
aj: Is this happening on fallback or proactive shim?
noah: It's proactive. We added a shim last month to handle clients that send old auth tokens. Shim returns 200 + compatibility headers but the quota path used is v2.
maria: Example trace (anonymized):
```
span: trace=abc123 tenant=tenant-9 auth=legacy-token shim=compat served=v2
metrics: increment(route=v2_quota)
```
tanvi: Console preview still reads: "Client appears to be using v1 credentials" with a deprec banner, but no "served" column. UX folks think we should show "served_variant" so customers see whether they were served by shim vs native v2.
aj: Telemetry note: our sampling for compatibility shims is 0.5% so we missed the initial spike. Need higher sampling for any route that triggers a deprecation banner.
noah: Impact: some customers saw unexpected cost increases because their app-level quotas were lower on v1, but shim forwarded them to v2 quotas. Also support tickets confused because console gave mixed signals.
maria: Proposed mitigation: (1) server patch to ensure quota emitter uses the original logical route for billing when shim is used and flag served_variant separately, (2) increase shim sampling to 5% and emit `served_variant` in spans, (3) console change: add served_variant column + deprec badge link to rollout runbook, (4) create an alert if shim_to_v2_rate > 3% for 30m.
aj: Implementation constraints: billing team only consumes route tag `billing_route`. Changing semantics is risky. We should add `served_variant` as a new tag and keep `billing_route` set to original_route until billing team signs off on changing to served route.
tanvi: For the console UX: I can wire a small table change to show both `original_route` and `served_variant`. That will be low-risk. I'll also add a tiny inline explanation: "Original route: what the client requested. Served variant: the runtime path that handled the request."
noah: Server change plan: add a flag in shim code: `emit_billing_route = originalRouteIfLegacyToken()` and `emit_served_variant = actualHandler`. Add unit tests and a migration note for billing.
sre-bot: rollcall: canary window requested 2024-12-02T02:00Z for routing-shim fix -> canary 2% traffic. CI: pending tests.
aj: Who owns end-to-end? noah for server, tanvi for console, maria to coordinate billing signoff and alert. I'll create a runbook section for "shim billing reconciliation" and add a temporary retrospective check to reconcile last 7 days.
maria: Also add a console banner for affected tenants: "You may have been routed through a compatibility shim. Check billing reconciliation." Small copy in product review.
tanvi: I'll mock the banner and the dual-column preview tonight. Will ping for a quick UX review tomorrow. :mag_right:
noah: I'll open PR for shim switch with tests and a migration doc. Plan: canary 2% for 24h, then 10% next day if healthy.
aj: Telemetry change: bump shim sampling to 5% and create metric shim_to_v2_rate. Add alert if >3% for 30m. Make sure this appears in the deprecation dashboard.
maria: Thanks. Resolve when billing signoff + server patch in prod + console preview shipped. Marking follow-ups in the deprecation board.
